system_prompt_style.note: Paper excerpt does not describe how the system prompt is built. No repo was in the bundle.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we not only leverage the knowledge graph to retrieve repository information during the localization phase, but also equip the suggester with the toolkit
env_context_strategy.note: KG-based retrieval plus agent-driven tool navigation. The KG is structural, not BM25 or embedding retrieval, so 'mixed' is the closest value.

context_compaction.note: A 'Summarizer' appears in Fig. 2, but its role in history compaction is not described in the excerpt. No config surface was available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: the tools themselves provide additional contextual cues and guidance to optimize the retrieval process

tool_call_format.note: Tool-call syntax is not described. No parser code was available.

tool_count.note: Paper counts only the KG toolkit. Fig. 2 also lists general tools (shell command, content search), so the total may differ.

edit_primitive.note: The excerpt does not describe the fixer's edit format.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependency or registry was available to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: SGAgentadopts a three-stage agent framework consisting of Locate, Suggest, and Fix phases, each handled by a specialized agent.
loop_primitives.note: The react loop is inferred from tool calls within stages. multi_attempt is inferred from candidate patch selection ('performs patch ranking and selection').

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: a repair suggester that performs backward analysis to convert coarse localization signals into actionable, repository-aware edit plans
planning_granularity.note: Suggestions are passed to the fixer as input. Whether they are stored as a structured object is unclear.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: three specialized sub-agents inSGAgent(i.e.,localizer, suggester, and fixer) collaborate to achieve automated end-to-end software repair

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: This suggestion𝑅 is then used together with𝐿as input in the subsequent repair phase.
delegation_mechanism.note: Output is passed stage to stage. Whether a new conversation is created per stage is unknown.

long_term_memory.note: The Neo4J KG persists repository structure, not agent memory.

self_verification.note: Based on Fig. 2 only. Self-Reflection also appears in the figure, but its mechanism is not described.

rollback.note: Fig. 2 shows 'Snapshot Storage', but its semantics are not described.

eval_hooks.note: The paper evaluates on SWE-Bench, but no repo was available to check for a built-in runner.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Suggestion-Guided LLM-Based Multi-Agent Framework for Repository-Level Software Repair
